basics.name: Yueci Deng (邓岳慈)
basics.label: Ph.D. Student · Systems, Simulation & Embodied Intelligence
basics.summary: I build high-performance simulation systems and learning infrastructure for embodied intelligence, connecting 3D perception, synthetic data generation, and Sim2Real robot learning.

education.institution: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen
details: School of Data Science. Supervisor: Prof. Kui Jia.

education.institution: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China / University of Glasgow
education.area: B.Eng. in Electronic Information Engineering / B.Eng. (Honours) in Electronics and Electrical Engineering
details: Joint college programme. University of Glasgow: First Class Honours.

highlights: Led core engine development for a Sim2Real embodied AI platform, spanning robot simulation and large-scale synthetic data generation.
Built training and deployment infrastructure and a unified computer vision and robotics library for product development.
Developed physics-based simulation, rendering, and domain-adaptation pipelines for robotic perception and control.
Developed 6D pose estimation, scene reconstruction, and collision avoidance for catering service robots.
Automated annotation for synthetic, mixed-reality, and real-world data; researched Sim2Real learning with Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School.
Developed point cloud registration, recognition, segmentation, and 6D pose estimation for industrial robot vision.
Led a cross-functional team developing bin-picking and 3D inspection products.
Developed projector autofocus and calibration algorithms for camera alignment, screen correction, and distortion compensation.
Prototyped 3D projection mapping and projected AR systems, and authored related patents.
Developed object detection, pose estimation, and point cloud processing for robotic picking.
Researched deep reinforcement learning for motion planning in simulation.
